title: Evaluation of a conjunction gate
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs, let $x$ be an input, and let $i$ be a gate with earlier gates $j$ and $k$. If gate $i$ is the conjunction of gates $j$ and $k$, then its value on $x$ is the conjunction of their values on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: Earlier gate indices j and k
Gate i is the conjunction of j and k
